mono-7078.d: The bridge rectifier as a schematic in standard symbols. Four diodes in a ring feeding a load: whichever way the supply swings, current flows through the load the same way. Measured before it was drawn.

mono-7079.d: The common-emitter amplifier as a schematic in standard symbols. One NPN transistor biased by a divider, with collector and emitter resistors: a small signal at the base comes out larger and inverted at the collector. Measured before it was drawn.

mono-7080.d: The inverting amplifier as a schematic in standard symbols. An operational amplifier with its feedback resistor to the inverting input: the output is the input times −Rf / Rin. Exact to the last figure shown.

mono-7081.d: The 555 astable timer as a schematic in standard symbols. The 555 timer wired to run free: the capacitor charges through Ra and Rb and discharges through Rb, making a square wave at 1.44 / ((Ra + 2Rb) C). The data is the drawing.

mono-7082.d: The lc tank circuit as a schematic in standard symbols. An inductor and a capacitor in a loop, trading energy back and forth at its resonant frequency 1 / 2π√LC. Computed, not invented.
